description: FreeCAD is an open-source parametric three-dimensional modeller. The FreeCAD project develops tools for drawing and changing solid geometry through a recorded model history, including workbenches relevant to architecture and engineering. Users supply dimensions, sketches and design constraints; outputs include editable solid models and exported geometry for a chosen asset. Its geographic coverage is any site represented in a user-created model. The project README links documentation, builds and source code, and GitHub metadata states LGPL-2.1 licensing. A limitation is that a CAD model by itself does not simulate energy demand, seismic response or operational performance. Geometry and material assumptions must be transferred to an appropriate analysis tool and checked after conversion. FreeCAD can prepare building or bridge geometry for infrastructure simulations. The related catalogue IfcOpenShell record is an IFC processing library, not the FreeCAD modeller. No installer, building model or project data was downloaded.
